record: Die neue Synagoge in Essen an der Ruhr, 1914, USHMM Rare Book Collection
facts: Edmund Körner’s measured ground plan, principal and side elevations, rear elevation and lengthwise section document the different masses and window locations.

record: City of Essen architectural heritage walk
facts: The synagogue was completed in 1913. The city records dimensions of 70 m long, 30 m wide and 34 m to the dome.

record: City of Essen roof and façade restoration, project page
facts: The standing shell is faced with shell limestone. Replacement prepatinated copper clads the main roof and the four corner roofs return to their original domed form.

record: Magdeburger Biographisches Lexikon, University Library of Magdeburg
facts: Architect Edmund Körner was born in 1874 and died in 1940.
